messages:
mariam: rolling out client-sdk v8.1.2 -> v8.2.0 canary (10%) now, paging/cursor changes included. will watch metrics for 15m :eyes:

deploy-bot: [deploy] canary rollout started for package redwood-client-sdk@v8.2.0 to cluster: canary-apis (10%) — triggered by mariam — ts: 2755001234

olivia: fyi i pushed the release notes to the release PR but called out a small cursor encoding change. patch: https://git.redwood/release/PR-8234 :memo:

raj: noted. quick heads-up — we saw a couple of customers with long-run streaming tests earlier this week hitting non-deterministic paging behavior. added a compat test but not in the canary matrix yet.

kevin: can we pause? i'm seeing a spike in 5xxs from canary on the metrics dashboard — paging errors up 2.8x. stacking results show most are from the streaming/paging endpoints. :rotating_light:

mariam: @kevin can you paste logs when you have them?

kevin: logs (redacted):
```
ERROR: paging_handler.go:214 - cursor decode failed: unsupported cursor schema version 0x3 -> expected 0x2
stack: runtime.go:45
request_id=abcd-1234 model=hosted-inference route=/v1/stream/paging
```

kevin: looks like the new client encodes cursors with an extra envelope; server-side decoder (legacy handler) rejects it. most are bucketed under `PAGING_CURSOR_MISMATCH`.

olivia: oh no — that matches the change in the client where we shifted to the envelope+sig format to support future signed cursors. i thought server decoding was backward-compatible, maybe the fallback isn't wired in for streaming.

mariam: incident-bot — declare SEV-2 for canary paging regression and page oncall.

incident-bot: :loudspeaker: SEV-2 incident opened: canary client-sdk v8.2.0 paging regressions. Incident channel: #inc-2755001234. Pager notified: oncall-sarah.

oncall-sarah: i'm on it — grabbing context. @mariam please post impact summary and any affected customers.

customer-success-amy: we already heard from a Tier-1 customer (AcmeRetail) complaining about truncated product feeds during their nightly sync. they're in Dedicated, but using the same client version. flagging potential cross-deploy impact.

mariam: impact so far: canary (10%) shows 15% of streaming paging requests returning cursor errors; 4% increased tail latency as retries kick in. Held rate-limited; Hosted production (100%) currently at baseline for this metric but one Dedicated customer reported issues (AcmeRetail).

raj: quick mitigation options: (1) flip feature flag that enables envelope cursor encoding in clients (if present), (2) rollback canary to v8.1.2, (3) server patch to accept envelope (hotfix). which is fastest?

olivia: we have a kill-switch feature flag: `client:v8:use_envelope_cursor` — default false, but some internal builds turned it on in the canary. if we flip to false, clients should stop sending the envelope. downside: clients already updated might keep using it until they get a config refresh.

mariam: what's the cadence for client config refresh?

kevin: client polls config every 60s by default, but some long-lived streams keep cached config until reconnect. flipping the flag will help new connections immediately. existing streams may continue to fail.

oncall-sarah: do the kill-switch now. then initiate rollback of the v8.2.0 canary to v8.1.2. we want to minimize customer impact.

mariam: executing kill-switch: `curl -XPOST https://config.redwood/api/flags/client:v8:use_envelope_cursor -d '{"value": false}'` — done. :white_check_mark:

eng-sre-bot: flag change propagated to 9/10 config nodes. remaining node in us-west still catching up.

kevin: ok i see config flips on new connections. error rate for canary decreased from 15% -> 6% in the last 2 minutes. still seeing failures on existing streams.

mariam: initiating rollback: `kubectl -n services rollout undo deployment/redwood-client-canary --to-revision=8.1.2` — starting now. deploy-bot will post status.

deploy-bot: [deploy] rollback initiated for redwood-client-canary -> target v8.1.2. watch: https://deploy.redwood/status/rc-12345

raj: can we apply a transient proxy rule to rewrite envelope cursors back to legacy payloads for existing streams? might be risky but would reduce customer impact quickly.

kevin: proxy rewrite would need to parse and re-encode cursors on the fly — doable but introduces CPU overhead and edge cases. i'd prefer rollback + hotfix on server to tolerate envelope quickly.

olivia: i'll prepare a small server patch to accept envelope cursors and fallback to legacy parsing; target patch 8.1.3-hotfix branch. can we force a faster rollout if rollback takes >5m?

mariam: agreed. Raj/Keven coordinate on rollback monitoring; Olivia produce hotfix. Sarah, please coordinate oncall handoff for the follow-up investigation.

oncall-sarah: i'll stay until rollback is healthy, then hand to @raj for postmortem prep.

kevin: rollback reached 100% on canary cluster. error rate down to baseline (within noise). :tada:

customer-success-amy: pinging AcmeRetail with interim update — told them we're rolling back and investigating. asked for logs and time ranges.

mariam: good work. next steps: 1) olivia to open PR for server compatibility patch (8.1.3-hotfix) and run canary tests with envelope cursors (owner: olivia). 2) raj to draft incident timeline and customer impact note (owner: raj). 3) kevin to run a replay test simulating long-lived streams with cached config (owner: kevin). 4) olivia & mariam to update release gating so cursor encoding change requires server compat flag.

olivia: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/PR-8352 — includes fallback decoder and unit tests. marking as hotfix and will request expedited CI.

raj: drafting timeline now, will include root cause hypothesis: client shipped envelope encoding behind a feature flag but some canaries had the flag enabled; server fallback for streaming didn't cover envelope path due to missing decoder registration in streaming handler.

mariam: handover: i'm tagging out in 30m, leaving follow-ups assigned. Sarah, keep an eye until fixes validate in canary.

oncall-sarah: will do. if anything flares, escalate to SEV-1. otherwise i'll move to monitoring-only in 2h and hand to raj for postmortem. :white_check_mark:

olivia: test results from hotfix smoke: envelope decode accepted, unit & integration tests pass locally. scheduling canary for hotfix in 10m after CI.

eng-sre-bot: canary rollout of 8.1.3-hotfix scheduled for 2755004120.

kevin: replay sim shows previously failing long-lived streams now succeed after reconnects; streaming sessions that never reconnect still had transient errors (expected) — will add a reconnect guidance note to release docs.

raj: posting customer impact note draft to the incident doc: https://docs.redwood/incidents/2755001234 — will tag teams and summarize remediation and timeline.

mariam: thanks everyone. closing action items in the incident doc and will run blameless postmortem next week. :coffee:

incident-bot: SEV-2 incident 2755001234 status: mitigated — rollback completed and hotfix in CI. Owner: raj.

customer-success-amy: shared final update with AcmeRetail: they confirmed recovery after rollback. asked to be informed when hotfix is live.

mariam: follow-up queue: update canary matrix to include streaming long-lived-client tests, require server compat signoff for cursor schema changes, add docs on reconnect behavior. assigning in the doc.

olivia: will also add a compatibility gate in the client release checklist.

oncall-sarah: handing to raj now for the write-up. i'm off-monitoring at 2755005120.

raj: taking postmortem ownership. thanks all. :bow:
